summary: Iteration 4 — all 5 features verified. Backend: 39/39 pytest tests pass (26 regression + 13 new for iteration 4). New coverage: /api/auth/forgot-password (unknown email + known email both return ok=true), /api/auth/reset-password (invalid code increments attempts; valid code succeeds, invalidates old session, cleans password_resets, returns new working session_token; expired code → 400 + cleanup; attempts>=5 → 400 + cleanup; short password → 400), /api/planner-weeks (returns weeks sorted by week_start desc with count, user-scoped/empty for fresh user), /api/export (returns app=PlanEat, version=1, dishes/weekly_plans/shopping_items lists, user info, auth-required), /api/import (merge preserves existing dishes by id, replace wipes+imports, auth-required). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): (1) Login screen shows 'PlanEat' brand + Italian tagline + 'go-to-forgot' link. (2) Forgot flow /(auth)/forgot: step 1 email input + send button; on send screen switches to code step with all 5 expected testIDs (forgot-code-input, forgot-newpw-input, forgot-newpw2-input, forgot-reset-button, forgot-resend); mismatched passwords produce 'Le due password non coincidono' error in [data-testid=forgot-error]. (3) Piatti tab header has settings gear (testID=open-settings) that navigates to /settings. (4) Settings screen shows all 4 buttons (btn-export, btn-import-merge, btn-import-replace, btn-logout); tapping btn-logout opens confirm-logout-modal; logout-cancel dismisses modal and keeps session. (5) Planner: duplicate-week-button opens duplicate-picker-modal listing available weeks with testID='duplicate-src-<week_start>'; tapping a row duplicates INTO current viewed week (verified slot count 0→1, shopping item 'Farina' appeared) and closes modal; duplicate-close X button also closes modal.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from an RN-web component (SafeAreaView / Modal). Non-blocking. Reference: emitted during login/register navigation.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-web warning; harmless but noisy in console.
(Optional) Note in /app/memory/test_credentials.md that localStorage key is 'cdc_session_token' (relevant if agents need to script auth from the browser).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot_password (L319-372): Correctly returns ok=true for both unknown and google-only accounts (enumeration-safe), deletes prior reset codes before inserting new one, 15-min expiry, bcrypt-hashed code, guardrails-passing email template.

server.py reset_password (L375-406): Solid — expired/exceeded attempts both clear the reset row; invalid code increments attempts; on success clears reset codes AND invalidates all existing user_sessions before minting a new one. Verified end-to-end.
server.py list_planner_weeks (L620-631): Filters weeks with non-empty slots, sorts by week_start desc; returns {week_start, count} — matches contract.

server.py export_data / import_data (L819-930): Export is a snapshot with app/version/exported_at/user/dishes/weekly_plans/shopping_items. Import in merge mode skips by id (dishes) / week_start (plans) / key (shopping); replace mode wipes user's data first. All user-scoped.
frontend/app/settings.tsx: All 4 backup + logout buttons present with correct testIDs; logout requires confirmation modal — good UX.
frontend/app/(auth)/forgot.tsx: Two-step flow works, mismatched password validation triggers before hitting API, resend button re-invokes forgot-password endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Fresh test_it4_<hex>@t.co user registered via API for backend; dup3<ts>@t.co user + TEST_DupUI3 dish + 2025-12-27 planner slot created via UI+fetch for planner duplicate picker verification. Password reset records injected directly into mongo password_resets collection with bcrypt('123456') per playbook.
